authorization: User explicitly requested stacking native dot8 with fused K2 after both independent candidates failed.
objective: Determine whether fused K2 load/compute overlap makes exact Q6_K x Q8_1 native-dot8 arithmetic useful on gfx1201.

variants.registered_k1_dp4a: Phase13 registered source and binary; historical control only until exact combined candidate qualifies.
variants.fused_k2_dot8: Same fused-only K2 source and schedule, with only q6k_mmvq_consume_packet arithmetic replaced by the Phase17 v2 exact four-dot8-per-group construction.

required: candidate fused symbol retains next-K VMEM before current gate DP4A/dot arithmetic
native v_dot8_i32_iu4 appears in fused symbol
unfused Q6_K N=1 machine-code bytes remain identical to isolated K1 baseline
private bytes, scratch, and spills remain zero
no added VMEM/store count beyond K2 packet schedule

correctness_gate.cases: Both GPUs, three repetitions, fused and unfused Q6_K K=3072/5120/8704 plus Q4_K fallback, NMSE <=0.0005 using the identical Phase16C harness.

performance_gate.condition: Run only after static and correctness pass.
performance_gate.exact_operation: Full-graph fused ffn_up M=8704,N=1,K=5120 with normal HIP graphs.
performance_gate.schedule: Three AB/BA rounds, six untrimmed samples per variant/device.
performance_gate.first_comparison: fused_k2_dot8 versus fused_k2_dp4a: combined >=1.02x, no device <1.00x, each spread <=3.5%.
performance_gate.promotion_comparison: Only after first comparison passes, compare against registered K1 DP4A and require >=1.005x exact. TG128 remains prohibited unless both exact comparisons pass.
